cause: 45000ms native execution budget counted from claim; task runtime limit exceeded before task_settle. File was written but no settlement was submitted.
fixes: Return an unknown EXECUTION_TIMEOUT receipt after native cleanup when local deadline expires and worker authority remains valid.
Normal worker polling retries durable results with the same command identity; it never reexecutes the workload.
Task detail falls back to latest run.settled summary when no result report exists.

newCases: signed native runtime timeout receipt acknowledged by coordinator
polling recovery after submit outage without provider replay
polling recovery after lost ACK without provider replay

limits: Successful side effects alone do not prove task success; explicit validated settlement remains required.
Long outages, authority expiry, or a crash before result persistence still require reconciliation.
